title: Introduce probe-sampler and profile evolution playbook
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Add a probe-sampler utility that captures representative micro-benchmarks from model artifacts and seeds profile deltas; introduce a documented playbook for profile evolution and automated changelog entries when sampled metrics cross thresholds.
description:
Context: onboarding small/medium models revealed two recurring problems: 1) model profiles are often seeded with synthetic or hand-curated inputs that don't reflect production token distributions, and 2) small performance regressions (quantization, kernel selection) slip through because there isn't a lightweight sampling + changelog automation pipeline. This PR adds a probe-sampler tool and an opinionated 'profile evolution' playbook to improve onboarding fidelity and simplify changelog generation.

What this PR does (summary):
- Add probe-sampler: a CLI + python library that executes a short, configurable set of micro-benchmarks against a model artifact (local or remote) to collect latency P0/P50/P95, memory, and KV-cache hit patterns. The sampler produces a compact JSON 'probe' compatible with the model registry profile format.
- Introduce profile evolution playbook: documentation and a small state machine that recommends whether to patch an existing profile, create a variant, or pin a model-version based on probe deltas and stability heuristics. Playbook includes thresholds, suggested rollout (canary size, ramp schedule), and rollback criteria.
- Changelog automation: a hook that converts probe deltas into a human-friendly changelog fragment and attaches it to the model release draft. The hook is triggered on profile delta commits and includes delta context (metric changed, before/after, sample inputs).
- Migration & compatibility: add a compatibility layer that falls back to existing profile fields when probe data is missing; migration script converts a small subset of legacy profiles to include a 'probe_seed' entry for future sampling.
- Tests & CI: add unit tests for the sampler JSON schema, integration test that runs the sampler against a small test model artifact in CI, and e2e smoke check for changelog generation.

Why this is different from previous onboarding work: instead of long-running profile calibration jobs, probe-sampler is intentionally short (20-60s per run) and targets representative micro-benchmarks. The playbook encodes operational decisions so curators don't have to guess whether to bump a profile or make a variant. Changelog automation reduces manual release note churn.

Checklist (manual review recommended):
[ ] Validate the probe output on a few real model artifacts (we ran it against two in the feature branch test harness)
[ ] Confirm migration script on staging profiles before applying to production store
[ ] Review playbook thresholds (default P95 delta 15% for 'requires-variant')

Related: Linear ENG-2456 (model onboarding stability), PM-112 (release notes automation), SUP-897 (customer report about profile drift). Links: prototype sampler README: https://git.internal/redwood/model-registry/probe-sampler (internal), playbook doc: docs/profiles/evolution-playbook.md (this PR adds it).
